# A17′ — Traversal with Return

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](../README.md) · [Other face: A17 — Toroidal Circulation and the Arche-Topos](../A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos.md) · [Shared A/C root](AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

**Standing:** conjugate argument-proposal; the prime face of [A17 — Toroidal Circulation and the Arche-Topos](../A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos.md). The circulation-with-retained-displacement operation is the partner's argued derivation re-sited at simulation relays. Brief material is **Paraphrased** and scenario-modal. C-ground: S4/P3 — Plan / Lifecycle / Reconcile.

## #0

"For Agentworld, simulations have meaningful agency in the world. They directly cause things to occur; the membrane between simulation and simulated perforates… The passage is no longer simply real-to-sim or sim-to-real but a growing relay that can extend many orders deep: real-to-sim-to-real-to-sim-to-real, etc." ([q022](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q022)). [A17](../A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos.md) supplies the structure this relay needs and did not know it had: a traversal with a finite home that does not erase its travel. Depart from the world, act into it, return to a transformed origin, begin the next circuit from what the passage changed. The torus is not claimed as the relay's literal shape; it is the exact local operation — local closure, [[symbolon/matheme/quilt/topology.md#2-follow-a-loop-through-its-cover|Retained Displacement]] — given a body in the [[section-rooms/arguments/A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field|Arche-Topos]] the partner derives.

## #1

The winding is the provenance. A17's covering map: a closed surface-loop can lift to a plane path whose endpoint differs by an integer displacement `(m,n)`; the projected return is exact, and so is the difference the lift retains. The relay performs exactly this double bookkeeping. The surface-address returns — the forecast re-enters the world that produced it, the simulation's output becomes a real event — while the cover retains what the passage travelled: which models ran, which counterfactuals were tried, what each leg changed. Q9 states the retained-displacement side as the venue's own research question: simulations "not merely representing phenomena but, through the weight of their implications, recursively impacting and governing them, and consolidating predictive and counterfactual intelligence into new social and political systems" (PDF p. 57). The forecast altering the forecasted is not a paradox to be regretted; it is the winding the account must learn to record. [Q031](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q031) gives the same retention at agent grain: coherence "passed from sub-agent to artifact to sub-agent without meaningful loss" — the composite's loop closing over its own artifacts.

## #2

Not every circulation closes the same way. A17's flow-reading: rational slope closes periodically; irrational slope winds densely without closure. The relay's ecology has both: deploy-observe-retrain loops that close on a cadence, and adversarial sequences — "Friends and enemies formally simulate and counter-simulate one another in oscillating sequences that attempt to model the models of the models" (§5.3, PDF p. 25) — that wind without terminus. §5.4's chain of refraction compounds the mixing: relays at different resolutions, higher-order positions simulating lower-resolution events, "blurring the modeling of past, present, and future into kaleidoscopic translations" (PDF p. 26). The discipline this demands is A17's own: recurrence need not be periodic, and a trajectory need not close merely because its supporting surface has no boundary. A relay economy is not finished by running; it is finished by *returning* — or not at all.

## #3

Here is the argument's edge. **A relay that cannot return to the real surface is not a simulation of the world but a picture possessing its world.** The loop that closes only on itself — outputs becoming inputs with no leg back to what they represent, no reconciliation, no one who can carry the finding to the responsible ground — is the film without the exit, which [A32′](A32-prime-The-Mirror-Is-a-Film.md) completes at population scale in the essay's own film figure. A17 derives the distinction inside the partner's own body: a loop which merely repeats its display can leave its conditions unrecognised; the whole-bearing return makes the surface's dependence on what it cannot turn into surface increasingly legible. Q9's value question — whether a relay economy "will invite value generation, decay, or deception" — is this distinction in the venue's own terms: generation is the returning circuit, decay and deception its severed forms. [A34′](A34-prime-Direction-of-Dependence.md) carries the direction-question this opens.

## #4

Cyclic and telic return are different offices, and the difference is engineerable. Musical-v3 [§II-5.10](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-ql-musical-derivation-v3/taylor-2026-ql-musical-derivation-v3.md), as A17 retains it: operational recursion opens another performance, while telic return recognises the standing relation the performance has enacted. The relay's operational form is the re-run — another simulation, another pass; its telic form is reconciliation after the run: the winding completed, the travelled difference received as provenance, the standing relation between representation and represented recognised rather than merely re-entered. A cycle that cannot stop is the bellows demanding endless production; the return that can recognise is the player able to bring it to silence. The candidate materialisation with evidence is exactly the return-leg made procedural — reconciliation as a first-class stage of the lifecycle (S4/P3), not an afterthought.

## #5→0

The circuit closes where it opened, changed. The world that departed into the model is not the world the model returns to; the return that ignores this has learned nothing, and the return that honours it has kept its displacement. What must survive the passage is A14's list — source, excluded alternative, criterion, consequence, revision — and [A14′](A14-prime-Code-as-the-Ages-Logos.md) grounds the process-grammar that makes survival inspectable; [A18′](A18-prime-Traversal-Run-in-Code.md) completes the traversal's full grammar.

The page **returns-to** [A17 — Toroidal Circulation and the Arche-Topos](../A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos.md): traversal with return holds at relay grain — exact closure, retained displacement, the exit kept open — and to the root [A/C](AC.md), the full `0/1` field, whose ruling demands precisely this: attributable encounter with the result, carried back to a responsible ground.

**Depth Restoration:** the relay as toroidal body (figure, not literal shape), winding-as-provenance, periodic/dense flows mapped to retraining and adversarial economies, the chain of refraction, picture-possessing-its-world as the severed relay, and cyclic/telic return with reconciliation proceduralised are restored from the partner argument, musical-v3 §II-5.10, and verified brief passages (q022, q031; §5.3–5.4 and Q9 verified against the local transcription, PDF pp. 25–26, 57). Pass 2 recomposes the prose from the argument outward.

**Unresolved Delta:** Q9 and the §5.3–5.4 chain are uncarded in the source house (verified against the local transcription). Whether any deployed relay currently implements reconciliation as a lifecycle stage is open — this page states the demand and its formal image, not an implementation. The literal-topology question (whether any economy *is* a torus) is expressly not claimed; winding is formal image, as the partner insists.
